title: 复盘 Dropbox 2025 会议精简试点的成果
topic: 如何用团队试点和数据说明会议调整的价值？

source.title: Virtual First 2025: Designing a culture that drives impact
source.readingTitle: Dropbox 2025 会议精简试点：做法、结果与下一步
source.section: 年度业务回顾中的团队运营案例
paragraphs: 2026 marks five years since we committed to Virtual First, our operating model where remote work is the primary experience for employees, and we prioritize in-person connection through regular gatherings. In that time, we’ve moved beyond the “what ifs” to a much clearer understanding of what’s working, what isn’t, and what needs to change.

In 2025, we ran a Meeting Reduction pilot with developer teams that included practices like No Meeting Wednesdays, fewer recurring one-on-ones, and an async-first approach to alignment. The results were clear: 27% reduction in weekly meeting hours (1.8 hours), 20% fewer meetings per week, 28% increase in coding time, 80% of participants found the pilot effective, and 90% recommended scaling the guidance.
Our goal is to reduce the number of meetings that don’t deliver a strong return on investment, improve the ones that do, and protect important time for focused work.
translations: 2026 年是我们承诺采用 Virtual First 工作模式的第五年：远程办公是员工的主要工作方式，同时我们通过定期聚会优先建立线下联系。这段时间里，我们更清楚哪些做法有效、哪些无效，以及哪些方面需要调整。
2025 年，我们在开发团队开展了减少会议试点，做法包括“周三不安排会议”、减少固定的一对一会议，以及优先异步沟通以达成共识。结果显示：每周会议时长减少 27%（1.8 小时），每周会议次数减少 20%，编码时间增加 28%；80% 的参与者认为试点有效，90% 的参与者建议推广这些做法。
我们的目标是减少那些回报不足的会议，改进真正需要召开的会议，并保护重要的专注工作时间。

verifiedFacts: Dropbox 在 2026-01-29 发布了 Virtual First 2025 回顾。
2025 年开发团队会议精简试点包含周三不安排会议、减少固定一对一会议、优先异步沟通。
该试点报告每周会议时长减少 27%（1.8 小时）、会议次数减少 20%、编码时间增加 28%。
80% 的试点参与者认为试点有效，90% 建议推广指导做法；这是参与者反馈，不是所有 Dropbox 员工的意见。

notes.explain: pilot 表示先在限定团队测试做法，再根据结果决定是否推广。
notes.example: We are running a meeting reduction pilot with two product teams.

notes.meaning: 优先用异步方式达成共识
notes.explain: async-first 表示能用书面更新或异步工具解决时，优先不约实时会议。
notes.example: An async-first approach to alignment gives reviewers time to respond.

notes.explain: recommend + 动名词；scaling the guidance 指把试点指导扩展到更多团队。
notes.example: After the pilot, participants recommended scaling the guidance.

scenario.title: 虚构练习：向跨部门团队提议减少会议的试点
english: Fictional exercise: a cross-functional product team loses focus time to recurring status meetings.
The team will try one meeting-free morning, written async updates, and a six-week pilot.
Write three sentences: explain the practices, name two measures, and say how participants’ feedback will guide a scale-up decision.
chinese: 虚构练习：一个跨部门产品团队因定期状态会而缺少专注时间。
团队准备试行每周一个无会议上午、书面异步更新和为期六周的试点。
请写三句话：介绍做法、列出两项衡量指标，并说明如何根据参与者反馈决定是否推广。

firstAttempt.prompt: 根据 Dropbox 于 2026 年 1 月发布的 2025 年度回顾，给管理团队写三句话：说明开发团队试点采用了哪些做法；报告两项结果；概括参与者对推广的看法。
firstAttempt.sample: In 2025, Dropbox ran a meeting-reduction pilot with developer teams using No Meeting Wednesdays, fewer recurring one-on-ones, and async-first alignment. Weekly meeting hours fell by 27% (1.8 hours), while coding time rose by 28%. Eighty percent of participants found the pilot effective, and 90% recommended scaling the guidance.
firstAttempt.rationale: 明确这是一项 2025 年开发团队试点；按做法、可量化结果和参与者意见组织更新。

words.example: Most participants recommended scaling the guidance.
words.translation: 大多数参与者建议推广这套做法。

cloze.prompt: The pilot reduced weekly meeting hours by 27% (1.8 ______).

choice.prompt: 哪句准确概括了 2025 年 Dropbox 开发团队试点及其结果？
options: Dropbox eliminated every meeting across the company.
The 2025 developer pilot reduced weekly meeting hours by 27%, and 80% of participants found it effective.
All Dropbox employees saved 1.8 hours every day.
choice.why: 来源限定为 2025 年开发团队试点；1.8 小时是每周会议时长减少量，而不是每天或全公司每人数据。

output.prompt: 虚构练习：你的跨部门产品团队准备试行六周的会议精简方案。请写三句话：说明具体做法；报告两项将追踪的指标；说明怎样依据参与者意见决定是否推广。不要把虚构团队的目标写成 Dropbox 的实际结果。
output.sample: We’ll run a six-week meeting-reduction pilot with one meeting-free morning and async-first status updates. We’ll track weekly meeting hours and uninterrupted focus time. At the end, we’ll review participant feedback and the results before recommending whether to scale the guidance.
check: 说明试点采用的具体做法，并标注为本团队方案
根据结果和参与者反馈决定是否建议推广
